item.title: Kugelblitz – Mac-Native Google Earth Alternative
item.description:
📝 Everything comes from freely available geodata, straight from its publishers, OpenStreetMap from the Kugelblitz tile server; you need no account. Beside the globe Kugelblitz shows every body as an atlas: the same data flat in five projections, from the whole sheet to the finest images. The Library (⇧⌘B) opens directories and geoportals with map services from all over the world: aerial images, satellite images, elevation models, maps and buildings in 3D.
🔗 Read more: https://apps.metaebene.me/en/kugelblitz
